method: Fixed 60 workloads. Original five campaigns: seeds 0/7/2401, every playable empire and branch at standard difficulty; first playable/first route at relaxed and veteran seed 7. Two preserved 64-star/256-world stress runs stop at turn 120. Other workloads stop at a winner or turn 160. The desired branch is selected through a legal command and engine.ai drives the chosen player; every other empire uses normal endTurn AI. Baseline and proposed engines start independently, alternate execution order each step, validate every resulting state and compare every serialized byte after every step. Timings include active-player AI plus endTurn, excluding cloning, validation and comparison. One fixed eight-step warmup per implementation; no tuning search. No browser, GPU, render, input-latency or universal speedup claim.
